Digital Movement

UK keyword plan

For Martey's SEO team · Digital Movement · 26 October 2026 · v2.0

How we got to these 250 pages

Every keyword comes from Google data: Search Console first, then Keyword Planner, each checked on Google UK's top 10. No term is AI-suggested.

  1. SourceMartey's list

    29 terms 23 kept

    Each checked for searches, difficulty and Google's top 10.

  2. SourceSearch Console

    1,448 queries 455 with 20+ impressions

    Queries digitalmovement.uk already gets impressions for, 29 May to 23 Oct 2026.

  3. SourceKeyword Planner

    73,142 keywords

    National service terms, 239 UK locations × every service, industries, trades and specialist services. UK, 26 Oct 2026.

  4. FilterScope

    Only services we sell, UK only; jobs, courses, free, DIY, tools and how-to searches removed.

  5. FilterDemand

    1,074 candidate pages

    10+ searches a month (12-month average; 20+ for trades, 30+ for industries), grouped one page per search intent.

  6. CheckGoogle UK top 10

    1,633 keywords read 520 commercial pages

    Mostly agencies means buyers (Commercial, 60%+); guides and 'best of' lists mean people are still researching.

  7. RankSearch Console first

    250 pages 35 band A, 26 band B

    Pages with impressions are guaranteed and lead; then lead score; SEO takes at least half.

  8. BuildWaves

    67 pages in wave 1

    Wave 1 first; later waves where Search Console shows impressions after 8 to 12 weeks.

Pages we recommend

We recommend 250 pages: 10 national, 56 industry, trade or specialist and 184 location.

  • Orange rows and chips: from Martey's list
  • Keep = the focus keyword is from Martey's list, Add = added by this research
  • Band A: 100+ Search Console impressions or a click
  • Band B: 10 to 99 impressions
  • Not ranking yet = Search Console measured 0 impressions so far · Few impressions = 1–9.
  • Scroll sideways for every column.

Key insights

10 findings · 5 to act on
  • SEOCities
    Do

    Google already shows us for city SEO

    60–74

    average position for SEO in Leeds, Manchester, London and Birmingham

    Google shows digitalmovement.uk for SEO in these four cities around positions 60 to 75, pages 6 to 8 (London 60, Birmingham 64, Leeds 70, Manchester 74), with 23,865 impressions in all. They are band A and start Wave 1.

  • Search Console
    Do

    Impressions are rising

    +24%

    impressions, last 28 days against the 28 days before

    36,170 impressions from 26 Sep to 23 Oct against 29,271 from 29 Aug to 25 Sep. The average position moved from 77 to 65.

  • Search ConsoleGA4
    Note

    No organic leads yet

    0

    organic leads in Google Analytics 4, 7 May to 25 Oct 2026

    GA4 recorded 34 organic sessions and no organic form or phone lead. It counts visits only after cookie consent, so impressions and clicks are the earlier signal.

  • SEOWebsite development
    Do

    SEO leads the plan

    125 of 250

    pages are SEO pages (floor: 125)

    Across the UK locations, website design terms draw about 38,773 searches a month against 18,111 for SEO. SEO is the centre of the plan, so 125 places are reserved for it; 67 SEO pages came in through that floor.

  • AI search
    Note

    AI search works nationally, not by city

    1,751

    impressions for the national AI search page

    Only 1 of 239 places has a city AI search term with 10+ searches a month in Keyword Planner (ai seo agency london). City AI queries in Search Console (113 impressions) sit on the SEO city pages.

  • Lead generationTrades
    Avoid

    Trade 'leads' searches belong to marketplaces

    1 of 10

    trade lead-generation pages with a commercial top 10

    For searches like roofer leads or plumbing leads, Google shows lead marketplaces such as Checkatrade, Get Work, MyJobQuote and MyBuilder; marketplaces and lists are 34% of those top 10s.

  • IndustriesSpecialist
    Do

    Strongest industry and specialist pages

    56

    industry, trade and specialist pages in the plan

    Highest in the order: SEO consultant (289 impressions); Technical SEO (515 impressions); SEO content agency (1,722 impressions).

  • Locations
    Avoid

    Some place names mean somewhere else

    Perth, Halifax

    UK places left out because Google shows other countries

    Google's top 10 for 'web design perth' has 9 non-UK results, mostly Australian, and for 'seo services halifax' 5, Canadian and US. A page needs fewer than 3, so these stay out.

  • Search ConsoleLocations
    Do

    Places we had not listed already get impressions

    13

    new place pages from Search Console

    Walsall, Halesowen, Dudley and other places near Birmingham have 6,031 impressions between them, so each became a page once its Google top 10 was read.

  • Search Console
    Note

    9 of Martey's 29 terms already have impressions

    9 of 29

    terms with impressions on digitalmovement.uk, 29 May to 23 Oct 2026

    The other 20 have none yet. The list shows each term's Search Console figures next to its Keep or Drop.

How we measured

Search volumes
Google Keyword Planner, UK, English, read 26 Oct 2026. A keyword is included at 10+ searches a month on the 12-month average. The Searches column and the lead score use the average of the last 3 months (July to September 2026), so seasonal spikes do not distort them. Close variants share one figure, which every total counts once. The cell reads "no volume data" when Keyword Planner returns no figure for the term.
Difficulty
Semrush UK keyword difficulty where available. n.a. means no figure.
Cost per click
Google top-of-page bid range, low to high, in GBP. The cell reads "no bid data" when Keyword Planner returns no bid range for the keyword.
Trend
Q4 2025 is the monthly average of October to December 2025. Q3 2026 is the monthly average of July to September 2026.
Google top 10
Google UK's top 10, read on 26 Oct 2026 from a UK search index for 1,633 keywords and checked against 11 live Google reads (all within one band; 6 of 11 exact). For those 11 keywords the table shows the live read. Where fewer than 10 organic results were captured, the share is out of the results captured. Each result is classed as one of: agency, directory or list, guide, tool, jobs, non-UK or other. Lead marketplaces such as Checkatrade or Bark count as directories. Pages where 3 or more results were non-UK were dropped.
Intent label
Commercial: 60% or more of the top 10 are agencies selling the service. Mixed: 40 to 59%. Not commercial: under 40%.
Can we win
For each keyword we took the share of strong domains, and the share of pages built for that exact search, among the agency results in the top 10. A strong domain is one of the web's most visited sites, or one that appears in the top 10 for a large share of the keywords in this plan. Easier, Medium and Hard are relative to the other candidate pages. Semrush difficulty is shown for reference (most keywords show n.a.).
GSC / GA4
Search Console impressions lead the selection: they are demand Google already ties to the site. Search Console for digitalmovement.uk covers 29 May to 23 Oct 2026, and Google Analytics 4 (GA4) covers 7 May to 25 Oct 2026. GA4 counts organic visits after cookie consent. Impressions in the last 28 days are up 24% on the 28 days before, and Google already shows the site for SEO searches in Leeds, Manchester, London and Birmingham, around positions 60 to 75. Every page with 10+ impressions and a commercial top 10 is guaranteed a place in the 250 (61 pages). Each page shows its highest tier. Leads: 1 or more organic lead events in GA4 (form or phone). Clicks: 1 or more Search Console clicks. Top 20: a search with 10+ impressions at an average position of 20 or better. Visible: 10+ impressions. Few impressions: 1 to 9 impressions and no click. Not ranking yet: Search Console measured 0 impressions for this keyword on digitalmovement.uk (29 May – 23 Oct 2026), so it is a new opportunity.
Search Console gaps
Searches the site already appears for that were not yet on the keyword list. Queries with 20+ impressions come first as supporting keywords on their page, marked GSC (368 in all). UK places with 50+ impressions that are not among the 239 became candidate pages once their Google top 10 was read.
Industry & trades
301 candidate pages for industries, trades and specialist services, for example SEO for dentists, websites for tradesmen and technical SEO services. The Segment column shows Industry, Trades or Specialist service, so trades are their own group.
Lead score
Searches (last-3-month average) × share of agencies in the top 10 × cost per click × service weight (SEO highest) × can we win × our own traction (Search Console traction ×1.1 to ×1.5: 1.5 for clicks or 1,000+ impressions, 1.3 for 100+, 1.1 for 10+). Traction multiplies the score inside each group. The top page scores 100. The master list puts pages with Search Console impressions first (100+ impressions or a click, then 10 to 99), then the rest, each group ordered by lead score. Each search intent gets one page, and its focus keyword is the Commercial query with the most Search Console impressions (20+); only where there is none does Keyword Planner volume decide. The other keywords are supporting keywords.
Build wave
Wave 1 is 67 pages: every page with 100+ impressions or a click, the national, industry and specialist pages, and up to 25 of the top locations. Later waves follow where Search Console shows impressions after 8 to 12 weeks. Every page has unique content.
Priority
Search Console band first (100+ impressions or a click; then 10 to 99; then none), then lead score. Equal scores: Martey's list first, then searches.
Before you write
Please confirm each page's top 10 on live Google before writing.
